item.title: Yankees legend Reggie Jackson criticizes Pete Hegseth's leadership amid Iran conflict
item.summary: Baseball Hall of Famer Reggie Jackson slammed Pete Hegseth on X over shaking up Army leadership during the ongoing military operation in Iran.

item.title: Trump calls rescue of downed Air Force pilot an 'Easter Miracle'
item.summary: President Donald Trump praised the rescue of a downed U.S. airman in Iran as an “Easter Miracle," calling the mission one of the most daring operations in American military history.

item.title: Trump vows US will strike Iran’s power plants, bridges if Strait of Hormuz is not reopened
item.summary: President Donald Trump issues a profanity-laced deadline to Iran, threatening to strike power plants and bridges Tuesday if the Strait of Hormuz isn't reopened.

item.title: Art heist targeting million-dollar masterpieces exposes blind spots in museum defenses, expert warns
item.summary: Former FBI agent Geoff Kelly says museum art thefts are more common than people think, warning that open, welcoming spaces also create security vulnerabilities.

item.title: Surging UK Green Party pushes church-state split, critics warn of break from Britain’s Christian roots
item.summary: Critics slam the Green Party's vow to separate the Church of England from the state, calling it a direct assault on the nation's Christian heritage.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV invokes Pope Francis' final words in Easter plea against growing 'indifference' to war
item.summary: In his first Easter blessing as pontiff, Pope Leo XIV called for dialogue over domination, quoting Pope Francis' warning on global indifference.

item.title: Archaeologists uncover mysterious Christian artifact near waters tied to Jesus' ministry: 'No known parallel'
item.summary: A one-of-a-kind artifact recently found near the Sea of Galilee may shed new light on how early Christians practiced baptism in the ancient city of Hippos.

item.title: 'Duck Dynasty' star Sadie Robertson Huff offers a glimpse into her family’s Easter, from church to egg hunts
item.summary: Sadie Robertson Huff reveals how her family blends faith traditions with fun on Easter while helping her kids understand the holiday's true meaning.

item.title: Two secret Christians found each other in an arranged marriage miracle
item.summary: In an excerpt from "The DNA of a Doctor," a couple in an arranged marriage in India discovers they both secretly share the same Christian faith.

item.title: Federal judge blocks Trump push to collect race-based admissions data
item.summary: A federal judge in Boston temporarily blocked the Trump administration from forcing public colleges in 17 Democrat-led states to submit race data.
